title: Apply to replace a pesticide licence identification card
summary: You can apply online to replace a lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed pesticide licence identification card, or request a replacement if your licence was not received or had an error.
intro:
If your pesticide licence identification card has been lost, stolen, damaged or destroyed, you can apply for a replacement licence by completing an online form.

The form can also be used to request a replacement licence if you did not receive your licence or if it had a printing error.
what_you_need: Your current licence (if you have it)
Payment, as indicated on the form (if applicable)

faqs.q: What situations require me to apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You can apply if your licence identification card has been lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed. You can also apply if you did not receive your licence or if it had a printing error.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: Eligible applicants include Pest Management Technicians (PMT), Ground Applicators (GRN), Fumigators (FUM), Timber Pest Management Technicians (PMT-TP), and holders of other specified licences.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: Select the ‘Apply online’ button, complete the form, and then select 'Sign and submit'.
